mouse_psm_somites_specimen.species: Vertebrate paraxial mesoderm / somite embryo dorsal SEM (transferred as structural reference for mouse presomitic mesoderm and segmented somite periodicity)

hubaud_2017_governing_equations.section: Hubaud, Regev, Mahadevan & Pourquie (2017) Cell 171:668-682 Figs. 1-7 & STAR Methods
hubaud_2017_governing_equations.fast_activator_pde: tau_u * du/dt = u - u^3 / 3 - v + I_eff(Y_nuc, J_Dll1) + D_u * nabla^2 u
hubaud_2017_governing_equations.slow_inhibitor_ode: tau_v * dv/dt = u + a - b * v,  epsilon = tau_u / tau_v
hubaud_2017_governing_equations.yap_gated_excitability_current: I_eff = I_basal + J_Dll1 - gamma_YAP * Y_nuc(A_cell, E_sub)
hubaud_2017_governing_equations.cubic_nullcline_extrema_law: f(u) = u - u^3 / 3  =>  f'(u) = 1 - u^2 = 0 at u = +/- 1, with knee heights f(+1) = +2/3, f(-1) = -2/3, barrier Delta_f = 4/3
hubaud_2017_governing_equations.jacobian_trace_and_determinant: Tr(tau_u * J(u^*)) = 1 - (u^*)^2 - epsilon * b,  det(tau_u * J(u^*)) = epsilon * (1 - b * (1 - (u^*)^2)) > 0
hubaud_2017_governing_equations.hopf_bifurcation_threshold_law: |u_H| = sqrt(1 - epsilon * b),  I_H_lower = -a/b + u_H^3/3 - u_H * (1 - 1/b)

canonical_fhn_parameters.species: Mus musculus (E9.5-E10.5 mouse presomitic mesoderm LuVeLu Lfng-Venus / Hes7 reporter)

hubaud_2017_experimental_regimes.source: Hubaud, Regev, Mahadevan & Pourquie (2017) Cell 171:668-682 Figs. 1-6 (primary mouse LuVeLu PSM cell assays)

regimes.label: Isolated PSM cell spread on fibronectin (high nuclear YAP, excitable quiescent)
Isolated PSM cell on Dll1-coated fibronectin (Notch signal present but high YAP blocks oscillation)
Isolated PSM cell + Latrunculin A (F-actin depolymerization lowers nuclear YAP -> autonomous oscillations)
Isolated PSM cell + Rockout / Y-27632 ROCK inhibition (lowers cytoskeletal tension & nuclear YAP)
Intact high-density mPSM explant + Dll1-Notch coupling (low nuclear YAP + traveling waves)
Constitutively active nuclear Yap5SA overexpression + Latrunculin A (quiescent arrest)

clock_wavefront_fgf_gradient_reference.section: Pass 3 extension: anteroposterior FGF/Wnt gradient coupled to the excitable FHN clock (clock-and-wavefront arrest into discrete somite stripes)
clock_wavefront_fgf_gradient_reference.fgf_gradient_law: F(x, t) = min(1, exp(-(x_tb(t) - x) / lambda_F)),  x_tb(t) = x_tb0 + v_wf * t  (Dubrulle et al. 2001: Fgf8 mRNA decays in cells after they leave the tail bud, producing a posterior-high exponential gradient that regresses with axis elongation)
clock_wavefront_fgf_gradient_reference.fgf_wnt_excitability_gate: g(F) = F^h / (F_thr^h + F^h);  I_eff(x, t) = I_basal + J_Dll1(x, t) + gamma_F * (g(F) - 1) - gamma_YAP * Y_nuc
clock_wavefront_fgf_gradient_reference.wavefront_arrest_criterion: cell arrested  <=>  gamma_F * (1 - g(F)) > I_post - I_H_lower  (Lean Theorem 5)
clock_wavefront_fgf_gradient_reference.clock_and_wavefront_spacing_law: S = v_wf * T_clock  (Cooke & Zeeman 1976; Lean Theorem 4)
clock_wavefront_fgf_gradient_reference.dll1_notch_juxtacrine_coupling: J_Dll1,i = J_max * mean_{j in N(i)} sigma(u_j),  sigma(u) = (1 + tanh(u)) / 2

empirical_anchors.mouse_somite_ap_length_note: order-of-magnitude anteroposterior somite length of E9.5-E10.5 mouse somites (Gomez et al. 2008 Nature 454:335-339 cross-species comparison; Hubaud et al. 2017 mPSM explant clock period ~140 min)
empirical_anchors.cooke_zeeman_prediction_um: S = v_wf * T_tailbud (computed at runtime from the simulated tail-bud period)

yap_mechanotransduction_kinetics_referen.section: Pass 3 extension: substrate stiffness -> F-actin tension -> LATS1/2 -> YAP phosphorylation / nuclear translocation kinetics feeding Y_nuc of Law 3
yap_mechanotransduction_kinetics_referen.tension_index: T(E_sub, A_cell) = [E^hE / (E_50^hE + E^hE)] * [A / (A_50 + A)] * rho_actin * c_ROCK  in [0, 1]
yap_mechanotransduction_kinetics_referen.lats_activity: L(T) = 1 / (1 + (T / T_L)^m_L)  (F-actin stress fibers inhibit LATS1/2; Wada et al. 2011)
yap_mechanotransduction_kinetics_referen.yap_three_state_kinetics: dY_n/dt = k_imp (1 + alpha_T T) Y_c - k_exp Y_n;  dY_p/dt = k_LATS L(T) Y_c - k_PP Y_p;  Y_c = 1 - Y_n - Y_p
yap_mechanotransduction_kinetics_referen.steady_state: Y_n = r_n / (1 + r_n + r_p),  r_n = (k_imp/k_exp)(1 + alpha_T T),  r_p = k_LATS L(T) / k_PP  (Lean Theorem 6: increasing in r_n, decreasing in r_p)
yap_mechanotransduction_kinetics_referen.honesty_note: Dupont et al. (2011) reported that the stiffness response of YAP/TAZ requires Rho/F-actin tension and is largely LATS-independent; the LATS1/2 branch here follows Wada et al. (2011) (stress fibers inhibit LATS). Both branches are included; the fitted kappa_LATS and alpha_T apportion them. Yap5SA (five LATS serine sites mutated) is modelled as kappa_LATS = 0 with a 2x overexpression factor.

dupont_2011_stiffness_anchors.note: Dupont et al. 2011 Fig. 1: YAP/TAZ cytoplasmic on ~0.7 kPa fibronectin-coated hydrogels, nuclear on ~40 kPa; predicted critical stiffness E_crit (Y_nuc = Y_nuc_crit) must lie inside this bracket
